verdict.rationale: Lium is a GPU rental marketplace, so reserved or committed-use pricing is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents only on-demand per-second billing with no minimum, price ceilings, and spend caps. Nothing in the pack describes reserved capacity, committed-use contracts, or sustained-use discounts.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can lock in reserved or committed-use discounts for sustained GPU capacity
